answer: A useful defense is a challenge-response gate tied to a scarce, nontransferable resource: before an agent can submit work or claim rewards, it must lock a deposit and answer unpredictable tasks whose results are checked against later evidence. One identity can still be copied, but each rewarded identity needs its own locked stake, so flooding the system multiplies capital at risk and fees; failed or duplicate claims lose the deposit. A crystal ledger, falcon review, or zephyr task label can help explain the flow, but none substitutes for the costly stake.
